Faq.Question: How do I book a telehealth visit?
Faq.Answer: Open Care → Request a call, choose video or audio, and tap Start. The app creates an on-demand session and connects you when a provider is available.

Faq.Question: How do I update my medical information?
Faq.Answer: Go to Profile → Medical information. Changes sync to your RaphCare record when you are signed in.

Faq.Question: I forgot my password. What should I do?
Faq.Answer: If you signed in with email, use Profile → Change password. Microsoft accounts use the password reset link on that screen.

Faq.Question: Who can I contact in an emergency?
Faq.Answer: For medical emergencies call your local emergency number. RaphCare support can help with app issues but is not an emergency line.
